decisions.reason: Transactional email is featured on the home page and fits the firm's core cloud messaging strategy, so results appear to meet aspirations and the growing firm has slack to keep it.

The fax delivery optimization feature is close to the established fax business and cheap to maintain, so it is likely kept even with declining fax volumes because the firm has slack and is hiring.
